{{Quote|Major Lessev is in a period of emotional turmoil, torn between right and wrong. The Empire she had sworn loyalty to has, in fact, one much to destroy her life. For the first time, she has seen the Empire for what it truly is.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives|<ref name="CRO" />}}
'''Kerri Lessev''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].

==Biography==
===Meeting Palpatine===
Kerri Lessev was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]<ref name="CRO" /> around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]<ref name="Birth" /> on<ref name="CRO" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> When she was an [[Youngling/Legends|infant]], Lessev's [[Parent/Legends|parents]], who were [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], moved the family to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="CRO" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Gender/Legends|girl]] grew up in the peaceful, safe, and harmonious environment offered by the life of upper-class [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] and attended classes together with the children of other delegates.<ref name="TEA" />

At some point after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="CRO" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Lessev's parents, along with multiple other delegates and their subordinates who were opposing the actions of their former colleague, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], were arrested. Although the latter claimed that they had been placed in protective custody, after that point Lessev never saw her parents again.<ref name="CRO" />

As part of a carefully staged [[Media/Legends|media]] event that was transmitted [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] on the [[Imperial News Network (Galactic Empire)|Imperial News Network]], Lessev and the other children were then brought before Palpatine. The Emperor announced to them that their parents had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by "[[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]]" who had supposedly been protesting against his [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]]. Lessev, who&mdash;like many others&mdash;was fooled by Palpatine's insincere sympathy, was awestruck in the [[Emperor/Legends|ruler's]] presence and withheld her grief at the news.<ref name="CRO" />

===Ward of the Empire===
Lessev and the children of the other delegates subsequently became wards of the Empire. At the insistence of<ref name="CRO" /> the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial advisor]]<ref name="Insider84">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> [[Crueya Vandron]], the young orphans were made members of the [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] of<ref name="CRO" /> the pro-Imperial volunteer organization [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]],<ref name="Insider84" /> where they were given [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-round education in Imperial bureaucracy and culture as well as [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] operations and the methodology of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="CRO" />

The students of the Sub-Adult Group, including Lessev, performed various tests that trained each of them according to their natural talents and traits. After she was recommended for the [[Destabilization]] branch of Imperial Intelligence&mdash;which specialized in disrupting the existence of societies, governments, and entire civilizations&mdash;Lessev was placed in an experimental [[Infiltration]] training program. At the end of the program, the trainee was reassigned to Intelligence. There, Lessev underwent a period of indoctrination and thereafter training for double-agent duty, after which she was finally transferred to Destabilization.<ref name="CRO" />

===The turning point===
{{Quote|She helps the Alliance in her own way &mdash; by causing internal dissension and conflict. While the Emperor's intent was that she would help expose those who would oppose him, Lessev has also helped eliminate some of the Empire's most competent and capable officers.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives|<ref name="CRO" />}}
Not long before Lessev was sent into the field as a Destabilization agent, she finally had an opportunity to review the [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. After viewing numerous speeches by<ref name="CRO" /> the Alliance's [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|leader]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and [[Prince/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of Alderaan's [[House of Organa/Legends|royal family]], the agent came to believe that the Empire was cruel and evil and realized that the Emperor had arranged for her parents to be killed.<ref name="CRO" />

tasked with preventing high-ranking Imperial personnel from posing a threat to Palpatine's reign. Lessev was also secretly an ally of the Alliance seeking to weaken the Empire by causing the elimination of some of the most competent and capable Imperial figures.

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], by which time Lessev held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Major/Legends|major]], the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] celestial body [[Ank Kit'aar]] was noted as her last known location in Alliance [[General/Legends|general]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken's]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing various Rebel operatives.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Kerri Lessev was a skilled Imperial Intelligence agent. Her repertoire of skills included the abilities of command, stealth, and perceptiveness as well as the skills of [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forgery]], [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], and [[Thief/Legends|pickpocketing]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Kerri Lessev possessed a wardrobe of [[Shimmersilk/Legends|shimmersilk]] [[Clothing/Legends|gowns]]. At one point, she also wore an outfit consisting of a light-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] over a darker [[shirt]] and dark skirt, accompanied by a pendant [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]]. Her equipment also included a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and an unlimited [[Imperial Cash Voucher]]. Lessev wielded a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]], a [[Model 6 "Quick-6"]] [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], and a [[Vibro-shiv/Legends|vibro-shiv]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kerri Lessev was created by [[David R. Tulo, Jr.]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. She was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].<ref name="CRO" />
